purpose: Test one bounded connection statement-cache capacity change while preserving all retrieval behavior and original gates.

parent.selection: G remains rejected standalone. I uses G as an implementation base, excludes E/F/H runtime changes, and is measured directly against released v0.3.2.

prior_observations.scope: Previously saved instrumented profile only; not an uninstrumented speed estimate or causal proof.
prior_observations.static_template_family: Exact and stem routes are each bounded at96, so the union metadata IN query alone may have up to192 distinct placeholder counts. Other scopes, novelty pools, source-page and turn queries add statement templates. Actual default-workload cache misses have not been measured.
prior_observations.h_disposition: H paired p95 geometric improvement5.2895176599741305%; three adverse cells exceed5% regression. H was rejected and will not be included.
prior_observations.profile_caveat: SQLite execute self time includes query preparation and FTS/query execution. It cannot be attributed to reparsing or treated as entirely avoidable.

hypothesis: A fixed512-entry sqlite3 prepared-statement cache may reduce reparsing of variable-cardinality IN statements on a long-lived ordinary connection. This does not establish cache thrashing in the saved workloads and promises no benefit for a short-lived or already fitting workload.

sources.fact: cached_statements bounds the per-connection internal statement cache and defaults to128.
Python3.10 documents a default of100 cached statements.

change.applicability: Pass cached_statements=512 only when sqlite3.connect is the saved built-in _sqlite3.connect identity. A replaced/custom callable receives exactly the historical path, timeout=10, isolation_level=None arguments, with no new keyword.
change.no_sweep: Only this fixed prospective capacity is authorized. Do not test multiple capacities and choose a favorable result.
change.other_settings: Do not include H pager target or change SQL text/parameters, pager settings, mmap, schema, indexing, transaction boundaries, connection lifetime, result-cache flags, ranking, tokenization or dependencies.
change.inherited_fixture_fix: Carry only the already reviewed Python3.10 closure-order fixture repair from H: create the cursor before execute in the custom text_factory test. The original G failed CI remains preserved.

correctness_before_corpus.mechanism: Invented SQL only: authorizer observations demonstrate preparing a bounded working set once and reusing it while new bound values/results and committed mutations remain visible. Record counters, not latency claims; no benchmark corpus content or retrieval.
correctness_before_corpus.contracts: Test custom connect compatibility, native connection certificate, transactions/external committed changes/schema invalidation, existing result-cache behavior, and existing native-row/materialization/token/scope fixtures. Full output equality to v0.3.2 remains mandatory.
correctness_before_corpus.fallback: Do not remove any existing native-connection, cursor, ordered-column, value-type or mapping/exception fallback guard.

resources.boundary: 512 entries is a count limit, not a byte or process-RSS cap. SQLite owns prepared statements and may retain additional internal state/parameter allocations. No new application-managed query, evidence, result or embedding cache is added.
resources.release_gate: Retain all original initialization/ingestion/reingestion/RSS/storage reporting and the >10% mean increase review threshold. Any extra memory must be quantified and independently reviewed; do not hide startup or process costs.
resources.capacity_limit: 512 does not guarantee coverage of every session/source-turn/limit/scope working set; it is a fixed bounded prospective choice without a parameter sweep.

development.source: Commit exact I source and correctness receipt remotely before creating its binding.
development.data: Same old synthetic61/public1015 cohorts and frozen F recovery snapshot bytes; private new I worker copies only.
development.order: Same fixed profile-first and8 paired AB/BA workers as G/H. New I paths and intents. Complete raw payload hashes and every adverse cell retained.
development.durability: Remote exact started intent before each stage; save each complete result before the next worker. Never replay an already started stage or overwrite evidence.

formal_and_quality: The original14-cell/66248-call performance, numeric/resource, full payload, historical lexical/Q2 gates remain unchanged. No fresh IDs/content selected. Any combination with T1 requires its own final source freeze and all applicable tests. Do not add isolated candidate percentage improvements.
independent_review: optimize_text independently reviewed native-only applicability, unchanged custom call arguments, lack of real-workload thrash evidence, template-bound limits, retained parameter allocation possibility and unchanged resource gates before implementation.
